root_cause: The Space keypress on the checkbox unexpectedly closes the preferences modal, likely due to an intervening listener that treats Space as a close action.
repair_strategy: Add an early return for Space (keyCode 32) in the Modal's onKeydown handler to prevent the key from propagating to any close logic while preserving existing ESC and Tab handling.
expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Space on the weekly digest checkbox will toggle its state without closing the dialog, keeping the modal open and accessible.
functional_risks: If any other component relied on Space to close the modal via this listener, that behavior will be lost.
verification_requirements: Verify that Space on #weekly toggles the checkbox and leaves #prefs-modal with aria-hidden='false'.
Confirm that ESC still closes the modal and restores focus to the trigger.
Confirm that Tab still traps focus within the modal.
